correctness.rationale: The correction follows from the standard Steinberg reduction corner, Boolean separation in the unit space, the isotropy-periodicity identification, and a direct local-constancy criterion for singleton point masses. The one-loop and two-loop examples independently expose the two failures, and the unital-module repair is the standard idempotent corner adjunction.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The underlying corner, open-singleton, line-point, and source-fiber induction facts are prior work; the novelty claim is restricted to applying them to identify and sharply repair the two universal assertions in arXiv:2609.20230v1. Targeted searches found no public correction or equivalent diagnosis of that recent source.

value.rationale: The errors affect the foundational vertex-induction and isotropy-restriction constructions of a recent representation-theoretic preprint. The exact criteria separate scalar corners, isolated isotropy corners, and nonisolated paths, giving concrete repairs and reusable counterexamples.
